Did you know you can hold your order up to 90 days with William Wood?

To hold your order, simply tick "Hold my order in stock for up to 90 days" at checkout and select your desired hold date.

Alternatively, you can email hello@williamwoodmirrors.co.uk after placing your order, quoting your order number and the date you want to hold your order until. An advisor will be happy to assist you.
